report: Economic Well-Being of U.S. Households in 2025, May 2026
publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
population: US civilian noninstitutionalized adults aged 18 and over
method: Ipsos KnowledgePanel probability-based online survey; published estimates use post-stratification weights

facts.definition: Adults saying they would pay a hypothetical $400 unexpected expense exclusively with cash, savings, or a credit card paid off at the next statement
facts.locator: Emergency Savings and Unexpected Expenses; first paragraph describing the hypothetical $400 expense; Figure 24
facts.qualification: Would pay this way is not the same as being able to pay this way. The remaining 37% are not all unable to cover the expense.

facts.definition: Adults reporting money set aside in an emergency/rainy-day fund to cover three months of expenses
facts.locator: Emergency Savings and Unexpected Expenses; paragraph beginning Some financial challenges; Table 27 overall row
facts.qualification: Self-report about savings; not a verified balance or a prescribed personal savings target.

usage: Country and year appear with each finding. These are US survey findings, not global statistics, product results, user matches or evidence that this app changes savings.
design_reference_usage: Visual hierarchy, orange and graphite palette, and the weekly-planning narrative only. Unverified product claims in the reference were not adopted.
